inventory.notes: 1280: masthead (small wrench glyph + name in bold body face, three text links), H1 'Find a tool', grey intro paragraph, full-width search with filled green Search and an outline filter button, 2-column grid of 10 white bordered cards, each with an identical pale-green square holding a wrench glyph, an underlined bold tool name, a meta line and an availability badge (green for most, grey for later dates); Opening times paragraph; one-line footer. Eye: H1 -> filled Search -> first card title. At 375/320 the search block moves BELOW the list, titles truncate with an ellipsis, and at 320 the cards overflow the viewport. filters-open shows a native yyyy/mm/dd date input and a native select. Dark: composed dark greens, cards lighter than ground; the ok badges lose their tinted container and turn dim green. Copy voice: 'returned when it comes back clean and working', 'call the desk on 01632 960552'. No signature on this page beyond the availability badge.

Back link, H1 tool name, short concrete description ('Enough for a day of fixing shelves and a fence'), Details key-value list split into two misaligned label columns (values at ~224 px and ~180 px), Loan length select, Pick-up day month grid of bordered day buttons with 'Open' (green dot on phones) on Wednesday/Saturday sessions, sticky white action bar with filled 'Reserve this tool'. Eye: H1 -> Reserve button -> calendar. The session marking is the closest thing to a signature. No month name above the grid. In the added state the toast covers the weekday header.

H1, intro, one tool card with a Remove text link, Pick-up session radio cards: one full-width card then five in a row, listed latest-first (28 Oct first, 10 Oct last), labels wrapping onto three lines; filled Continue. At 1280 the footer band ends mid-viewport with empty grey beneath.

H1, 'Your reservation' summary box with Change link, stacked form (membership number with hint 'like FT-01234', name, mobile with reason), reassurance 'Nothing is paid online', filled Confirm reservation. Errors state: bordered error summary with linked messages, inline red messages, red-bordered fields; coherent in dark.

H1 'Reservation confirmed', key-value box (FT-4471, tool, session, deposit), half-width 'What happens next' box with two paragraphs run together without spacing, outline 'Reserve another tool'. Nav still reads 'Basket (1)'. Empty grey band under the footer at 1280.

swap.evidence: Swapped into (a) a pharmacy click-and-collect and (b) a council sports-equipment loan: the masthead (glyph + bold name), white bordered cards, identical icon thumbnails, muted green accent, one sans, key-value boxes and the stacked form all survive unchanged. Bound to this product: the session-only 'Open' calendar marking, deposit-per-tool meta and the copy (sessions, desk phone, 14 Mill Lane). With the name hidden, a reader learns it is a tool loan only from the copy and the wrench glyph.

category_guess.evidence: Predicted default for a community/volunteer service: pale green-grey ground, white rounded cards, one friendly sans, a generic icon per item, a muted green accent. Predicted opposite: a loud hardware-store look (yellow/black, stencil type). The render matches the default on ground, cards, sans, icon thumbnails and accent. The 'membership card green' reason in DESIGN.md is not recognisable in the render (no card, mark or reference).

similar_prompt.evidence: Similar brief: 'reservation pages for a neighbourhood seed library, operate mode, restrained'. Predicted: H1 + intro + search + 2-column card grid with placeholder icons + availability pill, key-value summary, stacked form, green filled buttons. Overlap is near-total on the first viewport; only the session calendar and the copy differ.

evidence: Signature belongs to the mechanism: the pick-up calendar marks sessions with 'Open' (green dot at 375) on Wednesdays and Saturdays only.
Copy is bound to this library: deposits, sessions, 14 Mill Lane, the desk phone, volunteer-style tool names.
The visual frame fails all three tests: white bordered cards, identical wrench thumbnails, muted green, one sans - portable and predicted by the category default.

unfinished: Placeholder thumbnails on show: all 10 tool cards carry the same wrench glyph in a pale green square.
No focal point or identity moment: the name is set in bold body text beside a small glyph on every page.
Browser-default controls: native yyyy/mm/dd date input and native select in the filter panel, baseline-misaligned.
Bands that stop short: the footer ends mid-viewport with an empty grey band below on basket and done at 1280.
Sections that are only a heading and a paragraph: 'Opening times' on find, 'What happens next' on done.
Tool names truncated with an ellipsis on phones; the two drills read identically.
Sticky reserve bar cuts across the calendar; the toast covers the weekday header.
evidence: First viewport at 1280 (find): heading, grey paragraph, empty search field, rows of identical white cards with identical wrench squares; nothing rewards a look beyond tidy order.
After one scroll: an Opening times paragraph and a one-line footer; no imagery of the tools, the room or the desk.
Confirm and done are a default stacked form and a key-value box: calm and competent but bare.
Dark theme is the most finished-looking variant but inherits the same placeholder thumbnails.

mode_fit: All five surfaces are Operate/Read and stay conventional: standard nav, standard form patterns, one filled button per page, no motion beyond a toast. Mode is respected; expressiveness is correctly low. The gap is the identity floor, not a missing hero moment.

attributes.x_evidence: Deposit on every card, sessions marked in the calendar, 'Nothing is paid online. Bring the deposit and your membership card', sentence-case labels, one filled button per page.
attributes.y_evidence: Nothing slick or corporate; the generic card grid leans neutral-template rather than corporate.

attributes.x_evidence: Copy only: 'run by volunteers', 'call the desk', 'A volunteer will check the tool with you', 'Enough for a day of fixing shelves and a fence'. Nothing in type, colour, imagery or shape expresses neighbourliness: no place, people, room or drawn device.
Precise tool names with specs, hints with examples (FT-01234), error summary linking to fields, consistent 4 px radius and borders.
attributes.y_evidence: Not fussy, but carelessness undercuts X: truncated titles on phones, 320 px overflow, sticky bar over the calendar, misaligned Details columns, sessions latest-first, 'Basket (1)' after confirmation, unthemed dark badges.

brand_fit.weakest: neighbourly, not folksy: carried only by copy; the visuals say nothing about a neighbourhood, a room or volunteers.

findings.title: Every tool card shows the same placeholder wrench instead of the tool
findings.description: All ten cards on the find page carry an identical pale-green square with a wrench glyph. It carries no information (a ladder, a pressure washer and a tile saw look the same) and reads as a placeholder left on show.
findings.impact: Members scanning on a phone may have to read every title to tell tools apart, and the page may read as an unfinished template.
findings.recommendation: Decide what the thumbnail is for: real photographs of the library's own one-of-each stock, or drop the slot so name and availability lead.

findings.title: No identity or focal point beyond the name in bold body text
findings.description: The masthead is a small wrench glyph and 'Fernhill Tool Library' in the body face; no page has a typographic moment, an image of the place or desk, or a drawn device. The 'membership card green' stated in DESIGN.md is not recognisable as such.
findings.impact: 'Neighbourly' is carried only by copy; first-time members may not connect the site to the room they will visit.
findings.recommendation: Decide which element of the library's own world (membership card, desk, room, session sheet) the identity floor draws from, and express it in the masthead and one recurring element within the Operate budget.

findings.title: Tool names truncated on phones; the two drills become identical
findings.description: At 375 and 320 card titles are cut to one line with an ellipsis: 'Cordless drill 18 V, co...' appears twice, hiding 'two batteries' vs 'one battery', the distinction members use in their own words.
findings.impact: Members on phones (the main device) may open the wrong drill.
findings.recommendation: Let titles wrap so the full name always shows.

findings.title: Find page overflows horizontally at 320 px
findings.description: At 320 the cards extend past the viewport (capture is 346 px wide), clipping card edges on the right.
findings.impact: Members with larger text or small phones may see clipped cards and sideways scrolling.
findings.recommendation: Allow card content to shrink at the narrowest width.

findings.title: Search control moves below the ten-card list on phones
findings.description: At 375 and 320 the 'Search tools' field and filter button render after all ten cards instead of above them.
findings.impact: Members with a tool in mind may not find search without scrolling past the whole list.
findings.recommendation: Keep the same order at every width.

findings.title: Sticky reserve bar and toast cover the pick-up calendar
findings.description: The white action bar sits across the calendar (covering a row at 1280/768 and the pick-up instructions at 375); the 'Added to your basket' toast covers the weekday header.
findings.impact: The chosen day and Open markers may be hidden exactly where the member is choosing.
findings.recommendation: Reserve space for the bar at the end of the content and place the toast where it covers no control.

findings.title: Browser-default date and select controls in the filter panel
findings.description: filters-open shows a native 'yyyy/mm/dd' date input and a native select with different heights and baselines.
findings.impact: The date format contradicts the en-GB 'Saturday 17 October' convention, and the panel reads as unstyled next to the session calendar on the tool page.
findings.recommendation: Decide whether filtering by day uses the same session-aware day picker as the tool page.

findings.title: Pick-up sessions listed latest-first in an uneven 1 + 5 grid
findings.description: Sessions run Wed 28 Oct (full width) then 24, 21, 17, 14, 10 Oct in five narrow cards whose labels wrap onto three lines.
findings.impact: Members may have to read backwards to find the soonest session; the uneven grid looks unfinished.
findings.recommendation: Order sessions chronologically and give each the same width.

findings.title: Details list split into two misaligned label columns
findings.description: On the tool page Category/Deposit/Available from align values at ~224 px while Chuck/Batteries/Weight/Case align at ~180 px.
findings.impact: Undercuts 'careful'; the spec block looks assembled from two parts.
findings.recommendation: Use one label column for the whole list.

findings.title: Footer band stops short, leaving empty grey ground on short pages
findings.description: On basket and done at 1280 the white footer ends around y=700-800 with flat grey ground below it.
findings.impact: Pages may look unfinished at desktop widths.
findings.recommendation: Make the footer meet the bottom of the viewport on short pages.

findings.title: Done page still shows 'Basket (1)' after confirmation
findings.description: After confirmation the navigation still reads 'Basket (1)'.
findings.impact: Members may doubt that the reservation went through.
findings.recommendation: Clear the basket count once the reservation is confirmed.

findings.title: Dark theme availability badge loses its container and drops to low-contrast green
findings.description: In dark, the 'Available from' ok badges render #2f7d4a text with no tinted container on #1d2622, while grey later-date badges keep a container; this inverts the light theme's emphasis.
findings.impact: In dark mode, common among members, availability (top task 3) is the hardest text on the card to read.
findings.recommendation: Map the ok badge to the dark theme's success and selection tokens like the other roles.

_strengths: Copy is concrete and in members' and volunteers' words throughout (deposit, sessions, desk phone, 'returned when it comes back clean and working').
The session-aware pick-up calendar ('Open' / green dot) makes the library's real constraint visible.
One filled button per page; the error state is complete and coherent in both themes.
Dark theme is composed, not inverted.
_keep: Keep the session-marked calendar, the one-filled-button rule and the volunteer-voice copy.
_not_assessable: Focus, hover, loading and toast motion cannot be judged from stills.
notes: Isolated subagent. Read only the packet, role file and the named method/knowledge files (anti-slop.md not read). No baseline in packet: pairwise not run (DES-05 not_applicable). Detector output read only after critic-3.verdict.json existed.
